interface.signature: def scramble(s: str, indices: list[int]) -> str:

preconditions.description: The input s is a string and indices is a list.
The string and the index array have equal length.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: Every index in the array is a valid index for the string.
All characters in the string are alphanumeric (A-Z, a-z, or 0-9).

postconditions.description: The returned string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[indices[i]] == s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For every position i in the input string, the character s[i] is placed at the position specified by indices[i] in the result.
